source: Instagram Graph API v21.0 via Composio (connection instagram_metic-mutule)
coverage_caveats: 15 of 53 profile posts are not retrievable through the Graph API (likely predate the Creator-account conversion).
Media insights are limited to posts published within the last 2 years.

Account-level metrics (views, profile_views, accounts_engaged, total_interactions, likes, comments, shares, saves) were SILENTLY OMITTED by Meta for this account size. They are unavailable, NOT zero. Per-post data was used to reconstruct them.
follows_and_unfollows returned no total_value; unavailable at this account size.
media-level 'reposts' metric is rejected by the API (400). Do not request it.
